title: [SharePoint Graph] Follow-up corrections for UpdateListItem and drive item telemetry
summary: SharePoint Graph client corrections preserve unmodified fields during UpdateListItem operations and improve drive item telemetry with operation name dimensions.
key_points: UpdateListItem keeps ContentType, WebUrl, CreatedDateTime and LastModifiedDateTime when the record already holds the item
ParseListItemFieldValueSet returns Boolean; UpdateListItem logs a parse error under new event ID 0000UKW
Drive item update and rename operations log an OperationName telemetry dimension
GetListItem still appends the default $expand=fields to the endpoint so the caller's optional parameters are not mutated
New tests cover field preservation, empty field values and expand handling
